declarations.meaning: The concrete control state type has six values, independent of counter width.
Composition of literal transition runs.
One local flip and right move on a valid counter tape.
Resolving-bit flip and left move begins return phase.
Carry reaching the upper delimiter begins return without changing it.
One head-local return move across a bit.
Return through lower delimiter restores original head position.
Complete physical return over a finite traversed prefix.
Exact physical carry phase, with correct rewritten prefix and terminal flag.
Actual instruction-table execution returns updated fixed-width bits, flag, head and all exterior contents in2k+2steps.
No done state occurs before completion of the return phase.
No done state occurs during the carry phase.
First completion time equals the exact stated counter-step count.
Counter update on width zero.
Recursive update at a propagating bit.
Recursive update at the first resolving bit.
Each update preserves fixed width.
Carry prefix cannot exceed width.
Direction-specific potential is at most width.
One operation consumes carry credit and creates at most one new carry bit.
Literal primitive cost plus twice the new potential is at most4plus twice the old potential.
Repeated updates preserve width.
Telescoped potential bound for fixed-direction updates.
Sum of N actual primitive-call costs is at most4N+2w, in a single fixed direction; restarting controller not included.
Little-endian value lies below2^width.
Exact modular increment equation with overflow wrap.
Exact modular decrement equation with underflow wrap.
Terminal decrement flag detects exactly zero in the input word.
After overflow or underflow all output bits are the non-carry bit.
All-zero fixed-width word has value zero.
Increment flag detects exactly the maximum fixed-width value.
Positive value decrements by exactly one and does not underflow.
Before exhausting the initial value, N decrements subtract exactly N.
No early underflow in a countdown.
Starting withB−1, exactly the B-th post-emission decrement underflows.
B countdown primitive calls cost at most6B, conditional on local widthw≤B; reset/routing costs separate.

scope_limits: Amortization fixes increment or decrement direction for all calls.
Primitive arithmetic wraps modulo2^w. Underflow reports input zero and changes zero to all ones.
Counter initialization and local template reset are separate physical routines.
totalSteps excludes restart-controller, payload and stream-head movements.
No complete elementary stream or multiplication machine theorem.
